name: OpenAI API
desc: Developer API platform powering GPT, DALL-E and Whisper workloads
desc_zh: OpenAI 开发者 API 平台，支撑 GPT、DALL-E 与 Whisper 等模型调用
solves: Wiring up a model yourself means handling auth, retries, billing, and rate limits. Call these endpoints and it takes care of all of that.
solves_zh: 自己接模型要处理鉴权、重试、计费和限流。直接调这套接口，这些事它替你扛。
best_for: You are adding GPT, image, or voice capability to your own product.
best_for_zh: 你把自己的产品接上 GPT、绘图或语音能力时。
